input.title: fix(build): preserve calls edges over references on undirected collap…
input.body:
Fixes #2391.

The sort by (source, target, relation) before G.add_edge was added for deterministic collapse order, but that also meant alphabetical order picked the survivor whenever two different relations landed on the same (src, tgt) pair — references always beat calls since "calls" < "references". G.add_edge just overwrites, no merge.

Added a small _RELATION_PRIORITY table so the higher-information relation wins the collapse instead of whichever sorts last. Unlisted relations default to

output.summary: Fixes a bug where the deterministic edge sorting in an undirected graph could result in lower-information relations overwriting higher-information ones, leading to loss of important call edges.
output.risk_rationale: The fix changes how relations are prioritized during edge collapse, potentially affecting the integrity of the graph data. This could impact downstream systems that rely on accurate call graphs.
verification_targets: Correct edge survival when calls and references are added in both orders
No regression in existing test cases (14 pre-existing failures)
